Markets.title: Sebi chairman says cyber defence must move from IT issue to boardroom priority
Markets.summary: Sebi Chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey stated that cybersecurity must become a boardroom priority focused on resilience rather than just an IT concern. He also urged financial institutions to prepare for future quantum threats by adopting post-quantum cryptography.

Markets.title: Rupee slips as sentiment drags on RBI curtailing FX inflow window
Markets.summary: The Indian rupee weakened against the US dollar on Monday following the central bank's unexpected decision to shorten its forex swap timeframe. Persistent importer demand for dollars also contributed to the currency's decline, though analysts expect revised swap conditions to encourage future inflows.

Markets.title: Tempsens Instruments' Rs 650 crore IPO opens on August 20, price band fixed at Rs 285-300 per share
Markets.summary: Tempsens Instruments will launch its Rs 650 crore initial public offering on August 20 with a price band set at Rs 285 to Rs 300 per share. The India-based temperature sensor producer will use the funds for capital investments and debt settlement.

Markets.title: Zepto IPO: Raamdeo Agrawal says it was premature for the quick-commerce firm to tap public market. Here’s why
Markets.summary: Market veteran Raamdeo Agrawal called Zepto's IPO plans premature after the quick-commerce firm delayed its listing due to valuation concerns. He stated that companies should only enter public markets when they are profitable or nearly profitable because investors heavily prioritize earnings.

Markets.title: Bitcoin hovers near $63K ahead of Fed rate decision as investors assess liquidity outlook
Markets.summary: Bitcoin traded near $63,000 as investors awaited the Federal Reserve's rate decision amid geopolitical tensions and weak ETF flows. Analysts noted immediate support at $62,300 and resistance between $63,300 and $64,000 while major altcoins showed mixed performance.

Markets.title: Global Market: Euro zone bond yields hover near 15-year highs as Middle East war fuels inflation fears
Markets.summary: Euro zone bond yields remained near 15-year highs because Middle East conflict-driven energy inflation increased expectations for European Central Bank rate hikes. Germany's 10-year Bund yield held around 3.20%, while widening Italy-Germany spreads reflected growing geopolitical, inflation, and fiscal risks in the region.

Geo-Political.title: Trump says US to reduce military drills with South Korea after it stayed out of Iran war
Geo-Political.summary: President Trump announced the U.S. will reduce military drills with South Korea. He cited his strong relationship with North Korea's leader and South Korea's refusal to join the conflict with Iran as the reasons for the decision.

Geo-Political.title: Trump envoy Kushner meets Netanyahu after Hamas talks on peace plan
Geo-Political.summary: US President Trump's son-in-law, Jared Kushner, met with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. The meeting aimed to secure Israeli support for a US-backed peace plan for Gaza following discussions with Hamas.

Geo-Political.title: Ukrainian strikes kill six in Russia, acting governor says
Geo-Political.summary: Ukrainian strikes in Russia's Belgorod region killed six people, according to the area's acting governor. Four other individuals, including a 14-year-old child, were injured in the attacks.

Geo-Political.title: Aid shortages and fears of starvation as Indonesia reels from deadly earthquake
Geo-Political.summary: An earthquake struck Indonesia early on Saturday, killing 53 people and displacing thousands. The disaster has caused aid shortages and widespread fears of starvation.

Geo-Political.title: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo becomes deadliest in its history
Geo-Political.summary: The current Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is now the deadliest in the country's history. This historic epidemic is caused by a rare strain of the virus known as Bundibugyo.

Geo-Political.title: Top Zambian opposition figures arrested days after presidential vote
Geo-Political.summary: Top Zambian opposition figures were arrested days after a presidential election on allegations of participating in an insurrection plot. Meanwhile, the leading opposition candidate claimed that there was an attempt made on his life.

Data & Insights.title: Mint Explainer | Indian consumers are spending again. Can it last?
Data & Insights.summary: Indian consumer spending grew in the first quarter, driven by rural demand, premium products, and quick commerce. However, higher input costs and food inflation threaten to disrupt this ongoing economic recovery.

Data & Insights.title: Currency in circulation, ATM withdrawals, 10 countries, hinterland India… How UPI made a dent in the financial universe
Data & Insights.summary: India's UPI transaction value has reached 70% of the total currency in circulation. This rapid financial growth is driven by increasing adoption in small towns and rural areas beyond major economic hubs.

Data & Insights.title: India’s $20 trillion economy by 2036: The 5 growth engines that could unlock its next leap
Data & Insights.summary: An Equirus policy report states that India can grow into a $20 trillion economy by 2036. This ambitious economic leap relies on five specific growth engines: human capital, markets, services, governance, and currency.

Data & Insights.title: The week in charts: Price pressures, youth unemployment, chairman exit
Data & Insights.summary: This weekly data compilation highlights key insights on price pressures, youth unemployment, and a recent chairman exit. The report uses easy-to-read charts to help readers further explore major stories covered by Mint during the past week.

Data & Insights.title: India's WPI inflation cools marginally to 9.78% in July as fuel prices ease
Data & Insights.summary: India's Wholesale Price Index (WPI) inflation dipped slightly to 9.78% in July due to a moderation in fuel and power inflation to 20.05%. However, inflation for primary articles and manufactured products accelerated during the same period.

Data & Insights.title: India’s merchandise trade gap widens to a six-month high of $31.98 bn in July
Data & Insights.summary: India's merchandise trade deficit widened to a six-month high of $31.98 billion in July. However, total merchandise exports for the April-July period rose 17% year-on-year to $173.78 billion.

India.title: Ram Madhav Named Vice President In BJP 3.0: See Full List
India.summary: Ram Madhav has been appointed as a vice president in the BJP. Former Union minister Smriti Irani has been named as one of the eight national general secretaries.

India.title: Smriti Irani's Big Comeback As BJP 3.0 Gets Massive Women Representation
India.summary: Former Union minister Smriti Irani has returned to a core organisational role as a national general secretary of the BJP. This appointment is part of a massive representation of women in the party's new lineup.

India.title: 'Bhangra After Knee Replacement': AAP Health Card Video Triggers Political Row
India.summary: An Aam Aadmi Party health card promotional video featuring elderly people dancing after knee replacement surgery has sparked a political controversy. Opposition leaders have publicly questioned the authenticity of the medical procedures performed on the individuals shown in the footage.

India.title: Testing Agency Overhaul After UGC-NET Re-Exam, NEET-UG Paper Leak: Over 50 Staff Removed
India.summary: Following exam leaks and complaints, an NTA committee found multiple factual, typographical, and translation errors across three test papers. Consequently, the testing agency removed over 50 staff members as part of a major overhaul.

India.title: "Uncontrollable Crowd": 7 Killed, Many Injured In Stampede At Bihar Temple
India.summary: Seven people were killed and many others injured in a temple stampede in Bihar. Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary stated that the administration has been directed to provide proper and prompt treatment to the injured.

India.title: India Signs Rs 1,900-Crore Deal To Lease 2 MQ-9B SeaGuardian Drones
India.summary: India has signed a Rs 1,900-crore agreement to lease two MQ-9B SeaGuardian drones. This follows a separate $3 billion deal to procure 31 of the same drones from General Atomics for tri-service use.

General.title: Parents pushed to breaking point by Child Maintenance Service, BBC told
General.summary: Parents tell the BBC that the Child Maintenance Service has pushed them to their breaking point. Mothers struggle to force ex-partners to pay, while fathers report being wrongly charged thousands of pounds.

General.title: Burnham exchanged messages with person posing as Trump's chief of staff
General.summary: Downing Street declined to comment on a security breach reported by Politico. Andy Burnham exchanged messages with an individual posing as Donald Trump's chief of staff.

General.title: Rain on way for UK with temperatures to drop to overnight lows of 3C in some places
General.summary: Following a summer of heatwaves and drought, the UK weather will turn wetter and cooler this week. Temperatures are expected to drop to overnight lows of 3C in some areas.

General.title: Post-mortems due on five boys killed in crash on wrong side of motorway that injured four in Ireland
General.summary: Post-mortems are scheduled for five boys who died when their car was driven on the wrong side of a motorway in Ireland. Four others, including three women and a child in a second vehicle, were hospitalized with serious injuries from the crash.

General.title: Watch: Sprint sensation Amy Hunt takes gold number four at the European championships
General.summary: Amy Hunt won her fourth gold medal of the European Athletics Championships as Great Britain claimed victory in the event's first-ever mixed 4x100m relay. This historic win marked a successful conclusion to the competition for the British sprinting team.
